suggestions.signal_name: New Home Sales / Building Permits ratio
suggestions.observation: Sales-to-permits ratio captures absorption vs pipeline; a falling ratio (sales lagging permits) can flag demand softening before either level turns.
suggestions.rationale: Combines two housing leading indicators; the ratio may lead SPY more cleanly than either series alone by netting out common rate-driven trends.
suggestions.caveats: Both series NSA; ratio of two seasonal series needs joint deseasonalisation.

suggestions.observation: NHS response to the cycle is rate-state dependent (2022-23 shock).
suggestions.rationale: Gating the NHS signal by the mortgage-rate regime may sharpen it.
suggestions.caveats: Adds a second series; risk of overfitting the small OOS window.
